name: Puma
description: A panther is a large feline known for its powerful build, black coat, and exceptional predatory skills. It is a solitary hunter, primarily active at night, and adept at moving silently through its jungle or forest habitat.

actions.name: Pounce
actions.description: The panther leaps up to 3 units towards a creature, increased to 6 units of the panther is more than 3 units above their target. If the panther is hidden, the panther remains hidden after using this ability until after their next action or the end of their turn.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.description: While hidden, the panther makes a vicious attack against a creature using their claws and teeth, dealing physical damage. If this action is used on the first round of combat against a creature lower in the initiative order, it does 1d4 damage for each difference in initiative.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: After scoring a true hit using the Claw  action, the panther bites the same creature, dealing  physical damage. The creature must make a resilience check against the damage taken after mitigation or gain the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: The panther swipes their claws at a creature dealing physical damage.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.description: The panther does not suffer a stealth penalty when it moves while hidden.
